title: CASMI26 spectrum-to-fingerprint MLP
subtitle: MS/MS to Morgan fingerprint MLP + code for offline candidate ranking
description:
# CASMI26 spectrum → fingerprint MLP

A small model that reads an MS/MS spectrum and predicts the probability of each of the 2,048 bits of a Morgan fingerprint (radius 2). Candidates within a mass window are ranked by the log-likelihood of their fingerprint, which works for molecules that have no reference spectra (novelty classes 2 and 3).

Used in [CASMI26: finding molecules that aren't in any library](https://www.kaggle.com/code/aryanawasthiteykik/casmi26-finding-molecules-not-in-any-library).

## Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `fpnet_full.pt` | PyTorch state dict trained on all training structures. Use it for submissions. |
| `fpnet_val.pt` | Same model with every `enveda-np-examples` structure held out. Use it to validate honestly on those 250 timsTOF natural products. |
| `fpmodel.py` | Featurisation, model definition, training loop, fingerprint log-likelihood and the cosine gate |
| `casmi.py` | Mass helpers, peak cleaning, cosine library search, MRR@25, the novelty-class validation split |
| `fingerprints.py` | Morgan fingerprints for the candidate pool (RDKit) |

## Model

- **Input (2,514 dims):** fragment m/z in 0.5 Da bins up to 1000; neutral losses in 1 Da bins up to 500; adduct one-hot (10 test adducts), ion mode, collision energy, precursor m/z, peak count. Top 60 peaks, sqrt intensities.
- **Network:** 3-layer MLP, 1,536 hidden, LayerNorm + GELU + dropout 0.2, 2,048 sigmoid outputs.
- **Training:** BCE, AdamW, one-cycle LR 1e-3, 4 epochs, batch 512, up to 8 spectra per structure (1.3M spectra, 268k structures), spectra with |precursor error| < 20 ppm. About 27 minutes on 4 CPU cores.
- **Data:** competition `train.parquet` only. No NIST, no external spectra.

## Validation (simulated novelty classes, 250 timsTOF natural products)

| Method | Class 1 | Class 2/3 |
|---|---|---|
| Cosine library search | 0.939 | 0.051 |
| Fingerprint likelihood | 0.338 | 0.371 |
| Gate: cosine ≥ 0.7 first, then fingerprint | 0.785 | 0.337 |

## Usage

```python
import sys, torch
sys.path.insert(0, '/kaggle/input/casmi26-spectrum-to-fingerprint-mlp')
from fpmodel import SpectrumStore, make_model, predict_logits, fp_loglik
model = make_model(2048)
model.load_state_dict(torch.load('/kaggle/input/casmi26-spectrum-to-fingerprint-mlp/fpnet_full.pt', map_location='cpu'))
logits = predict_logits(model, SpectrumStore.from_frame(test_df), np.arange(len(test_df)))
scores = fp_loglik(logits[rows_of_one_molecule], candidate_packed_fps)   # higher is better
```
